newsitem.title: USA: DBT Online files for 1.64 mln shares.
newsitem.headline: DBT Online files for 1.64 mln shares.

text.p: DBT Online Inc filed Friday with the Securities and Exchange Commission a registration to sell up to 1.64 million common shares.

Of the total amount, one million shares will be sold by the company and 640,000 common will be offered by selling stockholders, the company said. After the offering, outstanding shares will total 8,750,818 common.

The underwriters have been granted a 30-day over-allotment option to purchase up to 246,000 additional common shares. The offering will be made through Credit Suisse First Boston and Invemed Associates Inc.
Net proceeds will be used for working capital and general corporate purposes.
DBT, based in Las Vegas, Nevada, is a holding company which operates through Database Technologies Inc and Paltex Corp.
